title: AutoFL: System and Benchmark Suite

description: Source code, benchmark suite, and generated client files for the paper Schema-Augmented LLM Prompting for Converting ML Training Scripts to Federated Learning Clients (ACM TOSEM, resubmission 2026). v2.0 corrects FedAvg to sample-count weighting, partitions the IID simulation, moves generated-module import to preflight Stage 1 in an isolated subprocess, adds a strict data mode, and versions the structured specification. It adds a rule-based template converter, a frozen 33-script expansion benchmark, runners for self-repair, prompt ablation, repeated sampling and differential tests, a consistency check against the manuscript, and a pinned Docker environment.
